release: Permanent data freshness reliability (November 24 CFP incident follow-up)
purpose: Narrow exception to the V6 protected-path guard for the reviewed freshness reliability change. Applies only to pull requests from freshness-reliability in this repository; every other branch keeps the strict byte-identical guard. Edited files are pinned to the exact reviewed content. No model, rating, prediction, data or published file changes. Remove after this release is merged.
